title: Introducing YAMPI: the MCP server for Dynamics 365 Business Central administration.
summary: YAMPI is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants like GitHub Copilot and Claude Desktop to manage Dynamics 365 Business Central environments through natural language commands. It simplifies BC administration by exposing 28 administrative tools across seven categories, eliminating the need to navigate multiple portals and APIs.
key_points: YAMPI provides 28 specialized tools organized in seven categories: authentication, environment management, application management, environment updates, session management, notification management, and feature management
Uses Microsoft Entra ID for enterprise-grade security with intelligent token caching and automatic refresh, avoiding repeated login prompts
Supports multi-tenant architecture for managing multiple BC tenants with seamless switching and independent secure authentication states
Can be installed via VS Code extension for GitHub Copilot or via npm for use with other MCP clients like Cursor and Claude Desktop
Abstracts away complexity of BC administration, enabling junior administrators to perform tasks through guided conversations and reducing the learning curve
features: Session Management (monitor active sessions, terminate sessions)
Environment Updates (check and schedule version updates)
Seamless Authentication via Microsoft Entra ID

quotes.text: The MCP server uses Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) for authentication, ensuring enterprise-grade security without compromising convenience.
quotes.why_it_matters: Addresses security concerns while maintaining ease of use, a critical consideration for administrators

quotes.text: The project is open-source and welcomes contributions from the Business Central community.
quotes.why_it_matters: Signals community-driven development and long-term sustainability of the tool
